source: 信仰庇护ShelteroftheFaithful。作为一名侍僧，你与同一信仰的同志互相尊重，并且可以随时主持相应神祇的神圣仪式。当你与冒险同伴遇到你所信仰神祇的神庙，圣坛或其他机构时，你们可能会得到免费的治疗和照料，但你必须为法术提供必须的材料成分。那些与同一信仰的同志会支持你（但仅限你）最基本的生活需求。
target: Shelter of the Faithful. As an acolyte, you and others of your faith respect one another, and you can officiate at your deity's sacred rites whenever needed. When you and your adventuring companions visit a temple, shrine, or other institution dedicated to your deity, you may receive free healing and care, but you must supply any material components required for spells. Others of your faith will provide for your basic living needs, but only yours.
reviewed_by: Codex root (AI full-text translation and contextual review)
note: Complete translation of the supplied 2014 short feature entry. Retains possible rather than guaranteed healing, required spell components, and the restriction that living support applies only to the acolyte. No extra temple paragraph from the separate long entry was added.

source:
信仰庇护 Shelter of the Faithful
作为一名侍僧，你与同一信仰的同志互相尊重，并且可以随时主持相应神的神圣仪式。当你与冒险同伴遇到你所信仰神的神庙，圣坛或其他机构时，你们可能会得到免费的治疗和照料，但你必须为法术提供必须的材料成分。那些与同一信仰的同志会支持你（但仅限你）最基本的生活需求。
 你可能还会与信仰相同的某神庙保持联系，并在该处留有一住宿地。这里可能是你曾服务过的神庙，而你仍与其团体关系良好；又或者可能是一座你在其中找到新归宿的神庙。靠近这座神庙时，你可以召来祭司提供帮助，而只要你所要求的协助风险不高，你就能一直与该神庙保持良好的关系。
target:
Shelter of the Faithful
As an acolyte, you and others of your faith respect one another, and you can officiate at your deity's sacred rites whenever needed. When you and your adventuring companions visit a temple, shrine, or other institution dedicated to your deity, you may receive free healing and care, but you must supply any material components required for spells. Others of your faith will provide for your basic living needs, but only yours.
You may also have ties to a particular temple of your faith, with a place to stay there. It might be a temple you once served and whose community still regards you well, or a temple where you have found a new home. While near that temple, you can call upon its priests for help, and you can remain on good terms with the temple as long as the help you request involves little risk.
reviewed_by: Codex root (AI full-text translation and contextual review)
note: Complete two-paragraph translation of the supplied long feature. Preserves the extra temple relationship, lodging, proximity and low-risk assistance clauses separately from the short feature.

source:
你投身于服务某个神或某个神系的神庙。作为神域与俗世的中间人，你负责主持神圣仪式与安排对神的奉献，并引导信众感受神能的显灵。你不一定是一名牧师，毕竟主持神圣仪式与引导神力是不一样的事情。
你可以从附录B的表格中选择某名神、某个神系或其他类神存在，也可以直接由你的DM进行介绍选择。然后与DM一同商定你投身宗教服务的生活细节。你是否自幼在神庙中长大，后来成为一名低阶神官？又是否作为一名高阶司祭，突然感召神的呼唤以另一种形式为其服务？也许你曾是远离神庙机构的某个小教团的领导者，或者曾经作为一个服务邪魔主子的神秘团体中一员。
target:
You have devoted yourself to serving a temple of a deity or pantheon. As an intermediary between the divine realm and the everyday world, you conduct sacred ceremonies, arrange offerings, and guide worshipers in experiencing manifestations of divine power. You are not necessarily a cleric: conducting sacred rites and channeling divine power are different things.
Choose a deity, pantheon, or similar divine being from the tables in Appendix B, or ask your DM to introduce an appropriate choice. Then work with your DM to establish the details of your religious service. Did you grow up in a temple and later become a junior priest? Were you a senior priest who suddenly felt called to serve your deity in another way? Perhaps you led a small religious group far from established temples, or belonged to a secretive group serving a fiendish master.
reviewed_by: Codex root (AI full-text translation and contextual review)
note: Full 2014 acolyte background description, including both paragraphs, Appendix B/DM options and all four possible histories. Cleric class and priestly service remain distinct.

source: 假身份FalseIdentity。你可以伪装成另一个身份，还附带关于该身份的相关的人证物证，并且必须先乔装打扮来让你进入角色。此外，你还可以伪造含有官方格式和私人笔迹的文书，前提是你必须曾见过此类文件以及目标的笔迹以作范本。
target: False Identity. You can assume another identity, supported by witnesses and physical evidence, and must first disguise yourself to take on the role. You can also forge documents that use official formats or another person's handwriting, provided you have seen examples of that kind of document and the handwriting to use as models.
reviewed_by: Codex root (AI full-text translation and contextual review)
note: Complete short 2014 feature. Preserves the supplied disguise prerequisite and the requirement to have seen both the document type and handwriting; does not add a different edition's feature.

source:
偏好骗局Favorite Schemes
   每个骗子都有比较偏爱的骗局手法。选择一个偏好骗局，或者掷骰随机决定。
d6 骗局
1  我在博弈游戏中作弊。
2  我造假币或者伪造文件。
3  我渗透进他人生活中，掌握其把柄，夺取他其财产。
4  我像换衣服一样换身份。
5  我在街角靠巧手耍把戏。
6  我说服别人花一大笔辛苦钱买不值钱的垃圾。
target:
Favorite Schemes
Every charlatan has a preferred kind of scheme. Choose one, or roll to determine it randomly.
d6 Scheme
1 I cheat at gambling games.
2 I make counterfeit coins or forge documents.
3 I work my way into people's lives, gain leverage over them, and take their property.
4 I change identities as readily as I change clothes.
5 I perform sleight-of-hand tricks on street corners.
6 I persuade people to spend a great deal of their hard-earned money on worthless junk.
reviewed_by: Codex root (AI full-text translation and contextual review)
note: All six supplied d6 entries translated in order without merging options. Retains first-person background-table voice and the leverage/property details of option 3.

你可以伪装成另一个身份，还附带关于该身份的相关的人证物证，并且必须先乔装打扮来让你进入角色。此外，你还可以伪造含有官方格式和私人笔迹的文书，前提是你必须曾见过此类文件以及目标的笔迹以作范本。

source:
你与人交流时总是很有一套方法。你明了对方的动机，并且在进行几分钟交谈和若干引导性提问后，就能如浏览儿科书般轻易的剖析对方的一切。而你也非常乐于以这份实用的天赋为冒险牟利。
你了解人们的欲求，并给予，或者答应给予相应的事物。人们的一般常识是警惕那些说过头的甜言蜜语，而你的技巧却能绕过这些常识。这瓶粉色药水绝对能治愈您那糟糕的皮疹，这神器的油膏（其实就是一些撒了点银粉的油脂）能让您重焕青春活力，刚好城里的那座桥要被拍卖了。这些天花乱坠的谎言在你的嘴里就如同事实一般。
target:
You have a knack for dealing with people. After a few minutes of conversation and a few leading questions, you understand what motivates them and can read them as easily as a children's book. You are quite happy to use this practical talent to profit from your adventures.
You understand what people want and give it to them, or promise to. Common sense tells people to beware of extravagant sweet talk, but your skill lets you get around those precautions. This pink potion will certainly cure that dreadful rash; this miraculous ointment, really just grease sprinkled with silver dust, will restore your youthful vigor; and, as it happens, the bridge in town is up for auction. In your mouth, these fanciful lies sound like facts.
reviewed_by: Codex root (AI full-text translation and contextual review)
note: Both supplied descriptive paragraphs and all three examples translated. The awkward book simile is rendered idiomatically as a children's book; no mechanical rules or additional schemes introduced.

source: 罪犯联络员CriminalContact。你有一个可靠可信的联络员，来帮你组织进罪犯们组成的联系网中。即使遥隔千里你也知道如何从联络人处收发信息。此外，你还知道哪些人能为你捎信，他们可能是本地的信使，可贿赂的商队主管，或是衣衫褴褛的水手。
target: Criminal Contact. You have a reliable, trustworthy contact who connects you to a network of criminals. You know how to send and receive messages through this contact even across great distances. You also know who can carry messages for you, whether a local messenger, a caravan master open to bribes, or a ragged sailor.
reviewed_by: Codex root (AI full-text translation and contextual review)
note: Complete short 2014 contact feature. Preserves the criminal network, long-distance messages and all three messenger examples; uses the supplied English feature name.

source:
作案手法Criminal Specialty
    违法犯罪的行为五花八门，而在盗贼公会或类似的犯罪组织中，每个成员也有着不同的专职分工。即便是那些游离于组织之外的罪犯，也会对某些特定的罪行更为偏爱。选择你在犯罪生涯中扮演的角色，或者依据下列表格进行随机投骰。
d8  手法
1 敲诈犯Blackmail
2 盗窃犯Burglar
3 斗殴犯Enforcer
4 销赃犯Fence
5 路匪Highway robber
6 职业杀手Hired killer
7 扒窃犯Pickpocket
8 走私犯Smuggle
target:
Criminal Specialty
Criminal activity takes many forms. In a thieves' guild or a similar criminal organization, members have different specialties. Even criminals who work outside such organizations favor particular kinds of crime. Choose the role you played in your criminal career, or roll on the following table.
d8 Specialty
1 Blackmailer
2 Burglar
3 Enforcer
4 Fence
5 Highway robber
6 Hired killer
7 Pickpocket
8 Smuggler
reviewed_by: Codex root (AI full-text translation and contextual review)
note: Full introduction and all eight d8 options preserved. Supplied English Blackmail and Smuggle are normalized to the agent nouns Blackmailer and Smuggler to match the Chinese occupational labels; no options replaced.

source:
罪犯接头人 Criminal Contact
你有一个可靠可信的接头人，来帮你组织进罪犯们组成的联系网中。即使遥隔千里你也知道如何从接头人处收发信息。此外，你还知道哪些人能为你捎信，他们可能是本地的信使，可贿赂的商队主管，或是衣衫褴褛的水手。
target:
Criminal Contact
You have a reliable, trustworthy contact who connects you to a network of criminals. You know how to send and receive messages through this contact even across great distances. You also know who can carry messages for you, whether a local messenger, a caravan master open to bribes, or a ragged sailor.
reviewed_by: Codex root (AI full-text translation and contextual review)
note: Complete separately located long-label entry; heading and paragraph preserved. Chinese contact synonyms refer to the same explicitly supplied English feature name.

source: 你是一位有违法前科的罪犯。且曾经在罪犯群中生活过一段不短的时间，而现在则仍然与罪犯的地下世界保持着联系。你比这世上的大多数人都要接近那些充斥在文明薄弱处的谋杀、盗窃和暴力事件，而你已经以藐视社会规则的态度活到了当下。
target: You are a criminal with a history of breaking the law. You spent a considerable time among other criminals and still maintain ties to the criminal underworld. You are more familiar than most people with the murder, theft, and violence found where civilization's grip is weak, and you have survived by treating society's rules with contempt.
reviewed_by: Codex root (AI full-text translation and contextual review)
note: Complete supplied 2014 criminal background paragraph. Retains past criminal association, continuing connections and the descriptive survival attitude without adding proficiencies or mechanics.

source: 人见人爱ByPoularDemand。你总是能找到表演场地，通常是酒馆或者客栈，偶尔也会是马戏团、剧院，甚至是贵族厅堂。只要你每晚维持出演，就可以在表演地获得简朴或舒适水平的免费食宿（取决于表演的规模）。此外，表演生涯使你在当地获得一定名气。当你在演出的城镇被陌生人认出时，通常都会受到善待。
target: By Popular Demand. You can always find somewhere to perform, usually a tavern or inn, and occasionally a circus, theater, or noble hall. As long as you perform there each night, you can receive free lodging and food at a modest or comfortable standard, depending on the scale of the performance. Your performing career also gives you some local fame. Strangers who recognize you in a town where you have performed will usually treat you kindly.
reviewed_by: Codex root (AI full-text translation and contextual review)
note: Full short feature, retaining nightly performance, both lifestyle standards and local recognition. Corrects only the supplied English heading typo ByPoularDemand to By Popular Demand, which is also supplied correctly in the neighboring full entry.

source:
演艺方向Entertainer Routines
    优秀的艺人应当多才多艺，并且能够在一次表演中以多种不同套路娱乐观众。自选一到三种套路或掷骰随机决定你作为艺人的技艺。
d10  演艺方向
1 演员Actor
2 舞者Dancer
3 吞火艺人Fire-eater 
4 小丑Jester
5 魔术师Juggler
6 乐师Instrumentalist
7 诗人Poet
8 歌手Singer
9 说书人Storyteller
10 杂技演员Tumbler
target:
Entertainer Routines
A good entertainer should be versatile and able to delight an audience with several different routines in a single performance. Choose one to three routines, or roll to determine your skills as an entertainer.
d10 Routine
1 Actor
2 Dancer
3 Fire-eater
4 Jester
5 Juggler
6 Instrumentalist
7 Poet
8 Singer
9 Storyteller
10 Tumbler
reviewed_by: Codex root (AI full-text translation and contextual review)
note: Full introduction, choice of one to three routines and all ten d10 rows retained. Row 5 has a Chinese/English mismatch (magician/Juggler); retained the explicitly supplied English Juggler rather than inventing an additional routine.

source:
人见人爱 By Popular Demand
你总是能找到表演场地，通常是酒馆或者客栈，偶尔也会是马戏团、剧院，甚至是贵族厅堂。只要你每晚维持出演，就可以在表演地获得简朴或舒适水平的免费食宿（取决于表演的规模）。此外，表演生涯使你在当地获得一定名气。当你在演出的城镇被陌生人认出时，通常都会受到善待。
target:
By Popular Demand
You can always find somewhere to perform, usually a tavern or inn, and occasionally a circus, theater, or noble hall. As long as you perform there each night, you can receive free lodging and food at a modest or comfortable standard, depending on the scale of the performance. Your performing career also gives you some local fame. Strangers who recognize you in a town where you have performed will usually treat you kindly.
reviewed_by: Codex root (AI full-text translation and contextual review)
note: Complete separate heading/paragraph entry. Matches the supplied short feature's meaning while keeping its own location and formatting; no extra benefits added.

source: 你在观众面前的表演生涯下成长。逐渐学会如何取悦他人，如何令他们着迷，甚至学会了如何激励他们。你的诗篇挑动听众的心弦，带动他们的喜怒哀乐。你的音乐振作他们的精神，或勾起他们的伤感。你的舞步令人着迷，你的幽默一针见血。无论你擅长何技，艺术即是你的生命。
target: You grew up performing before audiences, learning how to please them, captivate them, and even inspire them. Your poetry touches listeners' hearts and stirs their joy, anger, sorrow, and delight. Your music lifts their spirits or awakens their sadness. Your dancing enchants them, and your humor hits its mark. Whatever your specialty, art is your life.
reviewed_by: Codex root (AI full-text translation and contextual review)
note: Complete supplied entertainer description, preserving poetry, music, dance and humor as distinct examples. No feature benefits or ability proficiencies added to descriptive text.

source: 角斗士其实与巡游艺人或马戏师非常相似，他们学习以战斗场景娱乐大众的艺术。这种华而不实的战斗正是你的演艺方向，而你也可以同时掌握表演者或杂耍人的相关技术。你可以利用“人见人爱”特性在任何适合以战斗取乐的地点表演——可以是某个斗剑场，或是黑拳俱乐部。你可以将装备选择中的乐器替换为不昂贵且不常见的武器，比如三叉戟或捕网。
target: Gladiators are much like traveling entertainers or circus performers: they learn the art of entertaining crowds through scenes of combat. This showy fighting is your specialty, though you may also have the skills of a performer or juggler. You can use the By Popular Demand feature wherever people enjoy watching combat, such as a fighting arena or an underground fight club. You can replace the musical instrument in your equipment selection with an inexpensive, unusual weapon, such as a trident or net.
reviewed_by: Codex root (AI full-text translation and contextual review)
note: Complete supplied gladiator variant paragraph. Preserves the applicability of By Popular Demand, both venue examples, replacement rather than extra equipment, and both weapon examples.

source: 好客乡民RusticHospitality。你因来自平民阶层而在乡民群众中倍感舒适。除非乡民们已经认为你会带来危险，否则你总能在普通人群中找到一个地方以供躲藏，休息或复原。他们能够掩护你逃脱法办，或者逃离追杀你的人，只是他们并不会为你而牺牲自己的性命。
target: Rustic Hospitality. Coming from the common people, you feel at ease among them. Unless they already regard you as a danger, you can always find a place among ordinary folk to hide, rest, or recover. They can shelter you from the law or from those pursuing you, but they will not sacrifice their lives for you.
reviewed_by: Codex root (AI full-text translation and contextual review)
note: Full short 2014 feature. Preserves the exception when people consider the character dangerous, all three uses of shelter, and the limit against risking their lives.

source:
命定事件Defining Event
    从前你与民众一同从事某一项单纯的专职工作，你的可能是专职的农民，矿工，仆役，牧羊人，伐木工或是掘墓人等。但是由于某件事的发生，你便走上了一条不同的道路并标志着你此后的追求将更加伟大。选择或投骰随机决定一个命定事件以标志着你成为人们心中英雄的时机。
d10  命定事件
1 我挺身而出反抗某位暴君的代理人。
2 我在一起自然灾害中救了人。
3 我独自一人对抗一只可怕的怪物。
4 我偷窃了一名腐败商人的钱财再用来帮助穷人。
5 我领导一支民兵击退了一支入侵的军队。
6 我闯进某位暴君的城堡，并从中偷取武器武装民众。
7 我训练农民们以农具作武器抵抗某位暴君的士兵们。
8 为反对一项不公法令，我发起了一场象征性的抗议活动，随后当地领主就将其废止了。
9 一只天界生物，精类生物或是类似的其他生物赐我予祝福，或是揭示了我的秘密血统。
10 我被招募进一位领主的军队，期间我因自己的英雄气概而受到称赞，并被提升为领导者。
target:
Defining Event
You once worked alongside ordinary people in a simple trade, perhaps as a farmer, miner, servant, shepherd, woodcutter, or gravedigger. Then something happened that set you on a different path and marked the beginning of greater ambitions. Choose or roll for the event that made you a hero in people's eyes.
d10 Defining Event
1 I stood up to an agent of a tyrant.
2 I saved people during a natural disaster.
3 I faced a terrible monster alone.
4 I stole money from a corrupt merchant and used it to help the poor.
5 I led a militia in driving off an invading army.
6 I broke into a tyrant's castle and stole weapons to arm the people.
7 I trained farmers to use farm implements as weapons against a tyrant's soldiers.
8 I staged a symbolic protest against an unjust law, after which the local lord repealed it.
9 A celestial, fey, or similar creature gave me a blessing or revealed my secret ancestry.
10 I was recruited into a lord's army, where my heroism earned praise and promotion to a leadership role.
reviewed_by: Codex root (AI full-text translation and contextual review)
note: Complete supplied introduction and all ten d10 events translated in order, including all listed former occupations. Preserves the alternatives in event 9 and the distinct circumstances of events 5, 6, 7 and 10.

source:
好客乡民 Rustic Hospitality
你因来自平民阶层而在乡民群众中倍感舒适。除非乡民们已经认为你会带来危险，否则你总能在普通人群中找到一个地方以供躲藏，休息或复原。他们能够掩护你逃脱法办，或者逃离追杀你的人，只是他们并不会为你而牺牲自己的性命。
target:
Rustic Hospitality
Coming from the common people, you feel at ease among them. Unless they already regard you as a danger, you can always find a place among ordinary folk to hide, rest, or recover. They can shelter you from the law or from those pursuing you, but they will not sacrifice their lives for you.
reviewed_by: Codex root (AI full-text translation and contextual review)
note: Complete separately located feature with heading and line break. Retains the same supplied restrictions as its short version; does not add general village services or guaranteed safety.

source: 公会成员GuildMembership。你身为公会中一名备受尊敬的正式成员，可以享受到公会所提供的一些好处。公会中的同僚会在你需要时为你提供食宿，甚至在必要时为你安排身后事。公会在某些市镇设置有会馆，你可以以此作为与同行交流的场所，也可以从中开发潜在的客户、合作伙伴或雇工。
target: Guild Membership. As a respected, full member of a guild, you can enjoy certain benefits. Your fellow members will provide food and lodging when you need them and will even arrange your funeral if necessary. The guild maintains halls in some towns and cities, where you can meet others in your trade and find potential clients, partners, or employees.
reviewed_by: Codex root (AI full-text translation and contextual review)
note: Complete supplied short guild feature only. Preserves food/lodging, funeral arrangements, guild halls and all three kinds of professional contact; does not import dues or other paragraphs from a longer feature.
